change.title: pr-36882-flat
change.description: Add rolling-updates feature flag and compatibility framework
change.author: Cristian Sotomayor

findings.title: Operator guide says the Operator fails without rolling-updates, but nothing in the Operator checks it
findings.body: The CAUTION says that while `rolling-updates` is in preview it must be enabled, "Otherwise, the {project_name} Operator will fail." The Operator never reads the feature. `UpgradeLogicFactory.create` selects the upgrade logic only from `update.strategy` (operator/src/main/java/org/keycloak/operator/upgrade/UpgradeLogicFactory.java:36-42, via UpdateSpec.java:45-49), and `rolling-updates` does not appear anywhere under operator/src/main. With the feature disabled, a CR with `update.strategy: Recreate` is applied as written. The feature gates only the `update-compatibility` CLI (UpdateCompatibilityCheck.java:46, UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.java:46). Reword the caution to match that, or remove the failure claim.

findings.title: Should the operator guide say the feature must also be built into the server image?
findings.body: The example enables `rolling-updates` in `spec.features.enabled`, but the guide does not say the server image must be built with it. The Operator adds `--optimized` when a custom image is set or `startOptimized` is true (operator/src/main/java/org/keycloak/operator/controllers/KeycloakDeploymentDependentResource.java:296-299). The repository's own test image builds the feature in (operator/scripts/Dockerfile-custom-image:5), which suggests a runtime-only enable is not enough in that mode. Does an optimized start with an unbuilt feature fail, and should the guide state the build requirement?

findings.title: Feature-disabled path of `update-compatibility check` has no test
findings.body: The new gate at lines 46-50 returns exit code 4 and an error for `check`. The existing distribution test covers only the disabled path of `update-compatibility metadata`: quarkus/tests/integration/src/test/java/org/keycloak/it/cli/dist/UpdateCommandDistTest.java:47-50 launches `UpdateCompatibility.NAME, UpdateCompatibilityMetadata.NAME`. Nothing asserts the `check` message or exit code 4, which the docs now document (docs/guides/server/update-compatibility.adoc:132-134). Add a `check` case alongside `testFeatureNotEnabled`.

contracts.action: Run `update-compatibility check` without the rolling-updates feature enabled
contracts.before_after: Before: run() printed the preview warning, validated config, read the file and compared versions. After: the feature gate runs first; when disabled it prints the error and exits with 4 before the warning, validateConfig() and readServerInfo().
contracts.visible_effect: stderr 'Unable to use this command. The preview feature 'rolling-updates' is not enabled.' and exit code 4.
contracts.failure_mode: Picocli.exit only calls System.exit outside test launch mode (quarkus/runtime/src/main/java/org/keycloak/quarkus/runtime/cli/Picocli.java:203-207), so the `return` on line 49 is what stops execution in test mode. Profile is initialised before run(): the non-rebuild path calls PropertyMappers.sanitizeDisabledMappers() before cmd.execute (Picocli.java:127-129), which calls Environment.getCurrentOrCreateFeatureProfile (quarkus/runtime/src/main/java/org/keycloak/quarkus/runtime/configuration/mappers/PropertyMappers.java:296-306; quarkus/runtime/src/main/java/org/keycloak/quarkus/runtime/Environment.java:239-247). So Profile.isFeatureEnabled cannot hit a null instance here.

contracts.action: Run `update-compatibility metadata` without the rolling-updates feature enabled
contracts.before_after: Before: printPreviewWarning, validateConfig, compatibilityManager.current(), print and write metadata. After: gate first; disabled state prints the error and exits 4 without writing the --file output.
contracts.visible_effect: stderr error and exit code 4; no metadata printed and no file written.
contracts.failure_mode: Same as the check command: System.exit only outside test-launch mode, so the `return` on line 49 is required. No file is created when the gate fails, because writeToFile runs after the gate.

contracts.action: Incompatible result exit code, now RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE = 3 and FEATURE_DISABLED = 4
contracts.before_after: Before this PR the recreate constant was 4. After, recreate is 3, which matches the existing docs row m|3 (update-compatibility.adoc:128-130), and 4 is reserved for the feature-disabled case.
contracts.visible_effect: Exit code of `check` when the upgrade needs a recreate changes from 4 to 3; feature-disabled is now 4.
contracts.failure_mode: Any script that keyed on 4 as 'recreate' now sees 4 for 'feature disabled'. No in-repo consumer relies on the old value (grep of RECREATE_UPGRADE_EXIT_CODE/4 finds only IncompatibleResult). The command appears unreleased (no match in docs/documentation/release_notes).

contracts.action: Enable the new preview feature rolling-updates (Profile.Feature.ROLLING_UPDATES)
contracts.before_after: A new key `rolling-updates` (Type.PREVIEW, version 1). With --features=preview it is enabled because isEnabledByDefault returns true for PREVIEW under the PREVIEW profile.
contracts.visible_effect: Enabling `--features=preview` now also enables rolling-updates and lists it in the 'Preview features enabled' log line.
contracts.failure_mode: No failure path. FeaturesDistTest builds its expected preview list from Profile.Feature.values() (quarkus/tests/integration/src/test/java/org/keycloak/it/cli/dist/FeaturesDistTest.java:32-36), so it stays in sync.

contracts.action: Set update.strategy in the Keycloak CR while rolling-updates is disabled (the case the operator docs warn about)
contracts.before_after: Unchanged by this PR. The strategy alone selects AlwaysRecreateUpgradeLogic; no feature check is involved.
contracts.visible_effect: The Recreate strategy is applied with the feature disabled.
contracts.failure_mode: No operator failure. The guide's 'the Operator will fail' statement (advanced-configuration.adoc:449) is not reflected in code.

contracts.action: Set spec.features.enabled: [rolling-updates] in the Keycloak CR (UpgradeTest.createInitialDeployment and the guide example)
contracts.before_after: Before: the test set an UnsupportedSpec that was a no-op (disableProbes already sets unsupported). After: the test sets featureSpec.enabled to rolling-updates for the non-null strategy case, and setEnabledFeatures overwrites any previous list (none is set by getTestKeycloakDeployment).
contracts.visible_effect: The server is started with --features=rolling-updates for the recreate/rolling test cases.
contracts.failure_mode: When the image is started optimized without the feature built in, the start may fail; this is not verified. The default test image is not optimized (application.properties start-optimized=false), so UpgradeTest runs non-optimized and re-augments.
contracts.open_question: Does Keycloak fail to start when `--features=rolling-updates` is passed with --optimized to an image that was not built with it? This decides whether the guide needs to state the build requirement (see finding on advanced-configuration.adoc:477).

contracts.action: Build the operator test image with the feature built in (kc.sh build --features=rolling-updates)
contracts.before_after: Before: the build did not enable the feature. After: rolling-updates is built into the image.
contracts.visible_effect: Only the image built by operator/scripts/build-testing-docker-images.sh is affected; it is used when test.operator.custom.image is set.
contracts.failure_mode: If the build fails, docker build fails visibly. The stock image used by UpgradeTest does not contain the build-time feature (see the open contract above).

summary: Reviewed the 10 files of this part. No blocker or fix-level defects: the two CLI gates, the exit code renumbering (recreate 4→3, now matching the existing docs row), and the new PREVIEW feature key are consistent, and Profile is configured before run() so Profile.isFeatureEnabled cannot hit a null instance. Three findings, all consider: the operator guide says the Operator fails without rolling-updates but no operator code checks the feature; a question on whether the guide should say the feature must be built into optimized images; and the `check` command's disabled path has no test (only `metadata` is covered). One contract remains open: whether an optimized start fails when the feature is passed but not built into the image.
